criteria_verification.evidence: TestEnvelopeSourceIdIsJarvis is parametrised over _EMIT_SITES which lists both MessageEnvelope construction sites in src/jarvis/ (dispatch.py:_build_command_envelope at line 242 and dispatch.py:queue_build at line 811 — verified via Grep for 'MessageEnvelope\(').
